collateralizationRatio.rationale: System CR = sum over open non-denied positions of (collateralBalance × price-mapping CHF price) / protocol total ZCHF supply = 56269587.125448 / 34085375.45310237 = 1.650843. Position-debt-only variant 1.677483; protocol-API TVL variant 1.664512 (TVL 56735521.31 CHF is 0.83% above computed collateral). Ethereum eth_call totalSupply() at block 25627132 equals API ethereum-mainnet supply 30263459.15182019 ZCHF; global supply includes ~11.21% CCIP-bridged non-Ethereum supply.

liquidationCapacityRatio.rationale: Frankencoin liquidations clear through permissionless challenge auctions funded by external bidders who must hold/acquire the collateral asset; there is no ZCHF-denominated pool contractually committed to debt offset. The on-chain reserve pool (equity + minterReserve = 12455644.39 ZCHF = 0.365425 of supply at the pinned block) is loss-absorption capital under the backstop component, not committed liquidation capacity.

collateralizationParameters.basis: Per-position parameters are explicit on-chain and in the positions API: owner-set liquidation price bounding mintable debt, per-position minimumCollateral, reserveContribution observed at 10%–40% PPM (100000–400000), annualInterestPPM 1%–3%, challengePeriod mostly 1–4 days. New minters face a veto-window application with ≥2% qualified FPS votes able to deny. No protocol-enforced minimum collateral ratio beyond the owner-set liquidation price; sound pricing is enforced ex-post via challenges (oracle-free). Adequate rather than strong because CR discipline is auction-enforced rather than a hard system floor, and tokenized-equity lines (BOSS ~29.8% of computed collateral value) have no measured stress bound.

liquidationMechanics.basis: Permissionless challenge auctions with bid-switching design: bids above the liquidation price buy the challenger's collateral rather than the position's, making price manipulation expensive; 2% challenger reward; two-phase fixed-then-declining price. No oracle dependency. Docs explicitly require that challengers can acquire the collateral asset and that no position monopolizes a thin asset; no committed bidder of last resort exists. Dual-source: auctions documentation + position contract challenge fields observed on 71 open positions.

backstop.basis: Three documented loss layers: (1) challenged position's minter reserve contribution, (2) FPS equity, (3) general minter reserve; terminal coverLoss mints uncovered ZCHF if the reserve balance is exhausted (pinned Frankencoin.sol). At block 25627132: equity() 3820285.34 ZCHF (0.112080 of supply), minterReserve() 8635359.05 ZCHF (0.253345), combined reserve pool 12455644.39 ZCHF (0.365425 of 34085375.45 total supply). FPS market cap from protocol API ~$11.46M. Adequate capital depth but terminal path is dilutive inflation and no stress-tested bound against BOSS/tokenized-equity concentration is established.

branchIsolation.basis: Each position is a separate Ownable contract holding exactly one collateral type (positions docs + positions API: 71 open positions across 15+ collateral symbols). A failed position's collateral cannot be seized for another position's debt. Cross-branch transmission exists only through shared FPS equity and the general minter reserve after a position's own reserve is consumed. NOT established: any per-collateral debt ceiling limiting one collateral line's share of system debt (BOSS alone ~29.8% of collateral value).

shutdownAndBadDebt.basis: No global settlement or emergency shutdown mechanism is documented. Bad debt is socialized via coverLoss: reserve pool absorbs first; any shortfall is minted as new ZCHF to the loss source (Frankencoin.sol coverLoss). Dilutive inflation is the terminal path rather than a pre-funded wind-down. Dual-source: reserve docs three-layer protection + pinned source coverLoss mint branch.

structuralRedemption.basis: ZCHF holders have no direct redemption claim on position collateral. Structural exits are 1:1 stablecoin bridges (XCHF/VCHF/CHFAU and similar, with per-bridge limits) that burn ZCHF against locked source stablecoins, plus secondary markets. Challenge auctions repay position debt rather than holder claims. Dual-source: reserve balance-sheet treatment of bridge-locked stablecoins + overview/readme stating overcollateralized minting without holder-level collateral redemption.
